product.name: Monoprice Extension Cord - NEMA 5-15P to NEMA 5-15R 16AWG 13A/1625W 3-Prong Black 10ft
product.description: Extend the reach of your AC powered device with the Monoprice Extension Cord. This reliable and sturdy cable allows you to power your equipment from a distant power outlet, providing convenience and flexibility in your setup.Featuring a NEMA 5‑15P plug on one end and a NEMA 5‑15R receptacle on the other, this extension cord is designed to deliver power to your devices safely and efficiently. Simply plug your device into the receptacle and connect the other end of the cord to an AC power outlet, and you're good to go.With a 16AWG wire gauge, this cord is capable of carrying up to a 13 amp/1625 watt, 125 volt load, making it suitable for a variety of applications. It is recommended for powering computers, monitors, and other essential peripherals, ensuring that your devices receive the power they need to function optimally.Whether you need to replace a worn‑out or missing extension cord, or you require an additional one to connect devices such as computers, servers, or monitors to a power distribution unit (PDU), this Monoprice extension cord is an ideal choice. Its durable construction and 3‑prong design provide a secure and reliable connection, minimizing the risk of power interruptions or failures.This extension cord is built to meet high‑quality standards, offering peace of mind and reliable performance. The NEMA 5‑15P and NEMA 5‑15R connectors are widely compatible with various devices and power outlets, ensuring versatility in your power setup.With its 3‑prong design, this extension cord provides grounding, adding an extra layer of safety for your devices and reducing the risk of electrical hazards. You can trust in its ability to deliver consistent and reliable power to your equipment.Whether you need to power your workstation, set up a temporary setup in a different location, or simply extend the reach of your devices, the Monoprice Extension Cord ‑ NEMA 5‑15P to NEMA 5‑15R is a dependable solution that offers convenience, reliability, and peace of mind.
